tools.name: search_providers
tools.description:
Find scraping providers and products by name or category (scraping_api, web_unlocker,
    browser_api, scraping_platform).

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description:
A provider's products and sources, or with `product`, that product's plans, rate
    tables, limits, capabilities, price history and the official source of each fact.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description:
Compare up to three products on one workload: monthly cost range, chosen plan,
    capabilities, limits and caveats.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description:
Monthly cost (low / expected / high) of a workload on each product, with the cheapest
    plan that fits, rejected plans and every assumption used.

tools.name: recommend_scraping_stack
tools.description:
Recommend an architecture and up to three providers for a workload, with fit scores,
    cost ranges, reasons, limitations, assumptions and evidence URLs. Same input as
    POST /api/v1/recommend.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Price, plan and limit changes confirmed against official pages, newest first.
